_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the sibling GitHub checkouts bin/fleet-sync.sh
also keeps current, alongside the canonical ~/carr-system checkout.
Each entry is a directory name expected as a sibling of the carr-system
checkout, i.e. at ${REPO:h}/<name> (REPO is bin/fleet-sync.sh's own
canonical checkout root). Every sibling is assumed to be a plain git
checkout of github.com/jbookout/<name> on its default branch 'main'.
Not every Mac has every sibling checked out (Dell's Mac, for one, has
neither today). An absent sibling is a clean, ordinary skip — never a
Add or remove a sibling here ONLY; bin/fleet-sync.sh and its selftest
(ops/fleet-sync-siblings-selftest.py) both read this file rather than
carrying their own copy of the list.
